gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals and a commanding, expressive voice. Noto Sans Balinese stays modest underneath, keeping its curves open and its ascenders short.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Paprika spreads its letters out and lets the lowercase swell up like capitals, loud and expressive from the first word. Noto Sans Bamum settles underneath it, clean and modern.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Commanding up top, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that behaves like capitals and spaces its letters far apart. And Noto Sans Bassa Vah does the quieter job, with a big midsection and a wide-jawed c that keep the text contemporary.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-batak: Big, loose, a bit theatrical up top. Noto Sans Batak takes over below with a towering x-height and a wide e that never pinches, so Paprika's display swagger hands off to text that stays approachable and plain sans in manner.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Paprika is expressive and commanding, its scattered lowercase filling the line the way capitals would. But Noto Sans Bengali feels contemporary beside it, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and mouths that stay open.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Paprika runs wide and commanding, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals and counters that breathe. And Noto Sans Bhaiksuki is its approachable foil, a sans whose open apertures stay easy to make out.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Contemporary and neutral, with a high mean line and curves left open at the ends. Noto Sans Brahmi lets Paprika's expressive, widely scattered lettering take the spotlight, then carries on in a quiet sans voice.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Professional in manner, Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous room between curve ends and stems, with a high x-height. Paprika's expressive display letters sit above it, while the sans-serif text reads steadily on.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-carian: Lowercase that fills the line like capitals, spaced far apart, gives Paprika its commanding look. Noto Sans Carian follows in a clean sans with terminals held apart like scissor blades.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Approachable is the word for Noto Sans Chakma, whose lowercase packs up toward the caps and keeps the s and c uncrowded. And Paprika's loud, scattered display letters give that sans-serif text a big, expressive entrance.
